title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Blueberry & Raspberry 100ml Shortfill
description: Formerly known as Blueberry Sour Raspberry Blueberry Sour Raspberry from Double Brew is an irresistible flavour powerhouse that weaves together ripe, sweet Blueberries and tart Raspberries. This electrifying combination creates a delicious dance between sweet and sour, making for an unforgettable vaping experience. Double Brew is a brand new range of long-lasting 50PG/50VG 100ml shortfills from Ohm Brew. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle ensures your favourite e-liquid flavour truly goes the distance and provides 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot or two to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Unlike most shortfills, Double Brew offers their e-liquid in a 50VG/50PG ratio which makes it ideal for use in a vast array of vape kits and tanks, especially starter kits and low-powered pod kits. That 50/50 formula provides a perfect balance of flavour, vapour production and a smooth yet tactile throat hit. Since the liquid is thinner than most High-VG e-liquids, Double Brew Juice 50/50 shortfills are not suitable for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits. Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities.
